summary: Focused retest of iteration_15 follow-ups. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_iter16.py (15 tests) covering GET /api/events intra-day precision, POST /api/events garbage rejection + canonicalization of 4 valid formats (date-only, Z, tz-naive, tz-aware offset) with mongo persistence verification, GET /api/admin/events full-precision filter + 403 gate, and startup normalize-migration selectivity (SMN_ALLOW_RESTART=1: log shows 'normalized ISO timestamps on 1 legacy events' — only the legacy date-only row rewritten, the already-canonical row's updated_at sentinel untouched — PASSED). Full regression: 260 passed / 3 failed / 11 skipped / 1 xfailed. test_phase_g.py::TestCreateEventCanonical::test_ended_one_hour_ago_hidden now PASSES as requested. BUT the same-day fix introduced a new regression in the opposite direction: date-only (all-day) events normalize to midnight UTC and are therefore hidden by GET /api/events for the entire day they occur (test_phase_g::test_today_date_only_still_visible and test_iter16::test_date_only_today_all_day_event both fail). Frontend: found and fixed a CRITICAL crash — Profile.jsx used without importing it, so /profile rendered a full-page 'ReferenceError: Avatar is not defined' runtime overlay (confirmed with screenshot before fix, eslint jsx-no-undef). After adding the missing import, Avatar rollout verified end-to-end with a seeded dead picture URL across Feed, Header, Profile, CrewBank, CrewBankModal, OpenCrewSlots (Landing), PostComments, Reviews, Digest — zero broken (naturalWidth==0) on any page, zero page errors, fallback rendered as tinted 36x36 circle exactly matching h-9 w-9 and fully contained in the parent card, and emoji-only avatar (author_avatar='🐙') renders inside the circle bounds.

minor.issue: REGRESSION from the intra-day fix: date-only / all-day events are hidden on the day they happen. normalize_iso('2026-08-21') -> '2026-08-21T00:00:00+00:00', which is < now for the whole day, so an all-day event dated today never appears. Worse for Pacific users: an all-day event dated tomorrow local disappears at 17:00 PDT today (UTC midnight boundary). Aggregator single-day events survive only because the importer writes ends_at = next-day midnight, so they too vanish at 17:00 PDT on the event day. Suggested fix: compare against now for rows with a real time component but fall back to start-of-today (or ends_at + 1 day) for midnight/date-only rows, e.g. $expr with $max of (ends_at||starts_at) vs today_start when the timestamp ends in T00:00:00+00:00. Failing tests: test_phase_g.py::TestCreateEventCanonical::test_today_date_only_still_visible, test_iter16.py::TestIntradayPrecision::test_date_only_today_all_day_event.

Legacy rows with ends_at == '' (empty string) are matched by the migration filter but never repaired: normalize_iso('') returns None and the `if e and e != ...` guard skips the update, so (a) the migration re-scans that row on every boot and never converges, and (b) $ifNull:['$ends_at','$starts_at'] yields '' (not null) so the event is permanently invisible in GET /api/events and /api/admin/events regardless of starts_at. One such row exists in the current DB (id c2d51544-cd19-40cc-bdca-aa33f88ea063). Fix: treat empty/blank ends_at as an explicit $set to null. Failing test: test_iter16.py::TestNormalizeMigrationSelectivity::test_no_non_canonical_rows_remain.

Inconsistent with the new policy — still compares against now_iso[:10] (date-only). Either keep both date-only or move both to full precision so the events list and the open-crew-slots widget cannot disagree about what is 'past'.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: <Avatar> was used at line 105 without any import, so /profile crashed with 'ReferenceError: Avatar is not defined' (whole page replaced by the CRA runtime-error overlay). Added `import Avatar from "@/components/Avatar";`. Please keep the import; eslint react/jsx-no-undef catches this class of bug — run lint before shipping.

Minor inconsistency: when user.picture is absent, Profile falls back to the user's chosen emoji (user.avatar) but Header passes only user.picture to <Avatar>, so emoji-avatar users get the generic User icon in the nav. Pass src={user.picture || user.avatar}.
Boat Pro photo_url is still a raw with no onError fallback — a dead pro photo will show the browser broken-image glyph. Not part of this rollout's scope but the last remaining offender.

issues: Date-only aggregator events render as 'Aug 22, 2026, 12:00 AM' — the synthetic midnight from normalize_iso is shown as a real start time and misleads users. Suppress the time portion when the stored timestamp is exactly T00:00:00+00:00.

action_items: Restore visibility of all-day / date-only events on their own day while keeping intra-day precision for timed events (GET /api/events + GET /api/admin/events share the same $expr).
Repair ends_at == '' in the startup migration (set to null) so the row stops being permanently invisible and the migration converges.
Align GET /api/crew-bank/open with the events past-filter precision.
Keep the Avatar import added to Profile.jsx and add `yarn lint` (or eslint react/jsx-no-undef) to the pre-ship checklist.
critical_code_review_comments: The now-ISO comparison is duplicated verbatim in community_router.list_events and admin_router.admin_list_events; extract an `upcoming_event_predicate(now)` helper next to aggregator.past_event_predicate so the three filters cannot drift again.

create_event's local _is_valid() only checks the '+00:00' suffix; validate in schemas.EventCreate (pydantic validator running normalize_iso) so every write path — aggregator, admin, seed — gets the same guarantee instead of just this one endpoint.
normalize_iso fails open on unparseable input; consider a strict variant used by write paths so bad data can never reach mongo.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of avatar assertions after fixing the Profile.jsx import

seed_data_creation: Temporary mongo docs: user TEST_i16_ui_user (picture=dead placeholder URL, avatar='🐙', identity_verified), session TEST_i16_ui_token, post TEST_i16_post, comment TEST_i16_comment, crew_bank + crew_bank_standalone entries. All deleted after the run; seed_alex.identity_verified re-verified true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q` for the full suite; the migration-restart tests need SMN_ALLOW_RESTART=1 -o addopts=''. Expected remaining failures until fixed: test_phase_g::test_today_date_only_still_visible, test_iter16::test_date_only_today_all_day_event (all-day events hidden), test_iter16::test_no_non_canonical_rows_remain (legacy ends_at='' row). Avatar rollout is complete and verified across all 9 call sites; re-verify only if new avatar sites are added. Browser User-Agent header is required for backend requests.
rca_of_the_issue: Switching list_events/admin_list_events from today_iso (date-only) to datetime.now().isoformat() gives correct intra-day behaviour for timed events, but date-only inputs are canonicalized to 00:00:00+00:00, so their 'end' is the very start of the day. Any all-day event is therefore treated as past from the first second of its own day (and, in Pacific local time, from 17:00 the previous day). The filter needs to distinguish a genuine midnight-precision (all-day) timestamp from a timed one — e.g. keep a date-granularity comparison when the stored value ends with T00:00:00+00:00. Separately, ends_at='' bypasses the migration's update guard and defeats $ifNull, permanently hiding that event.
